units.source_text: 常陆守夫人曾在三条地方建造一所小小的宅院，作为回避凶神的地方。

en.t: The wife of the Governor of Hitachi had once built a small residence in the Sanjo area as a place to avoid an unlucky direction.

units.source_text: 屋宇本来简陋，且又尚未竣工，因此设备装饰都不很周全。

en.t: The building was plain to begin with, and since it was not yet finished, its furnishings and decorations were far from complete.

units.source_text: 她带浮舟到这宅院内，对她说道：“可怜啊！

en.t: She brought Ukifune to this residence and said to her, "Poor child!

units.source_text: 我为了你一人，赢得种种烦恼！

en.t: For your sake alone, I have taken on all kinds of troubles!

units.source_text: 在这个事与愿违的世界里，我实在不想待下去了。

en.t: In this world where everything goes against one's wishes, I truly do not want to remain any longer.

units.source_text: 如果只为我一人，即使降低身份，过着不像人的生活，我也会听天由命，闭居在一个角落里度日。

en.t: If it were only for myself, even if I had to lower my station and live a life unworthy of a person, I would accept my fate and pass my days shut away in some corner.

units.source_text: ……那位夫人，本来是不承认你为妹妹的。

en.t: ... That lady never acknowledged you as her younger sister in the first place.

units.source_text: 我们去亲近她，如果惹出不成样子的事情来，将被世人耻笑。

en.t: If we try to approach her and some disgraceful affair comes of it, people will laugh at us.

units.source_text: 唉，真无聊啊！

en.t: Ah, how pointless it all is!

units.source_text: 这里房屋虽然简陋，但无人知道，你暂且躲藏在这里吧。

en.t: Although this house is humble, no one knows about it, so hide here for the time being.

units.source_text: 我自会替你另图善策。”

en.t: I will find another good plan for you myself."

units.source_text: 她吩咐之后，自己就准备回家。

en.t: After giving these instructions, she herself prepared to return home.

units.source_text: 浮舟啼啼哭哭，设想此身在这世间何等命苦，便觉心灰意懒。

en.t: Ukifune wept and wept, thinking how bitter her fate was in this world, and her spirit sank into despair.

units.source_text: 她实在是怪可怜的，但母亲痛苦更甚，她觉得把女儿关在这里，委屈了她，实甚可惜。

en.t: She was truly pitiable, but her mother's suffering was even greater; the mother felt that shutting her daughter up here wronged her and was terribly regrettable.

units.source_text: 她总希望女儿平安无事地长成，如意称心地完姻。

en.t: She had always hoped her daughter would grow up safely and marry happily according to her wishes.

units.source_text: 如今遭逢了那件可悲可恨之事，深恐被外人看作轻薄女子，甚可担心。

en.t: Now that this sorrowful and hateful thing had happened, she feared deeply that outsiders would see her daughter as a frivolous woman, and she was terribly worried.

units.source_text: 这母亲并非不明事理的人，只是容易动怒，又略有些儿刚愎自用。

en.t: This mother was not someone who failed to understand reason; she was simply quick to anger and somewhat stubbornly self-willed.

units.source_text: 其实不妨把浮舟隐藏在自己邸内。

en.t: In truth, there would have been no real harm in hiding Ukifune within her own residence.

units.source_text: 但她以为隐藏在自己家里会委屈浮舟，所以决定采取这办法。

en.t: But she thought hiding Ukifune in her own house would be unfair to her, and so she decided on this course.

units.source_text: 母女两人多年以来形影不离，朝夕相见，如今突然分居，彼此都不胜寂寞。

en.t: For many years mother and daughter had been inseparable and had seen each other morning and evening, so now that they were suddenly living apart, both were overcome with loneliness.

units.source_text: 母亲对女儿说：“这屋子还没有完全竣工，生怕有不谨慎之处，你必须小心在意。

en.t: The mother said to her daughter, "This house is not yet fully finished, and I fear there may be careless shortcomings, so you must be very cautious.

units.source_text: 各处房间里的侍女都可叫来使唤。

en.t: You may call the maidservants from any of the rooms and have them serve you.

units.source_text: 值宿人员虽然都已吩咐过了，还是很不放心。

en.t: Although I have already given orders to everyone on night duty, I still cannot feel at ease.

units.source_text: 然而那边常陆守要生气，故我不得不回去，真痛苦啊！”

en.t: But the Governor of Hitachi will be angry over there, so I have no choice but to go back. How painful this is!"

units.source_text: 母女两人挥泪而别。

en.t: Mother and daughter parted in tears.
